title: Quickstart templates: add production-readiness checklist + basic monitoring pointers
author: Wei Chen
description: Context: As part of the guided onboarding + “first production launch” workstream, we want quickstarts to do more than “hello world”. This PR updates the quickstart template(s) to include a small, explicit production-readiness checklist section and basic monitoring pointers, while keeping the path-to-first-response unchanged. Scope is intentionally minimal: add guardrails guidance (timeouts/retries, 429 handling, request IDs), point users to Console usage metrics, and provide starter logging hooks that don’t require a full observability stack. What’s included: 1) New README section: “Before you ship to prod (10–15 min)” with checklist items: set timeouts, add retries with jitter for transient errors, handle 429s with backoff, distinguish test vs prod API keys, log request IDs, and confirm usage/latency in Console. 2) Added small code snippets per template (Node/TS + Python): a) where to set client timeout, b) a basic retry wrapper (with guidance to use the SDK defaults where available), c) recommended logging fields (status, model, latency, request_id). 3) Monitoring pointers: link to Console → Usage dashboard, plus a note on forwarding logs/metrics (e.g., OpenTelemetry) without prescribing a vendor; includes a short list of “signals to watch” (p95 latency, 429 rate, error rate, token spend). 4) Clarified rate limit behavior: added a short callout about concurrency bursts vs token quotas, and that 429s can occur during onboarding if scripts are run in parallel. 5) Small cleanup: unify env var naming in templates (REDWOOD_API_KEY), add a “prod key” reminder, and fix a couple of outdated doc links in the template README. Notes/Non-goals: This does not attempt to fully automate checklist validation (that lives in Console/backend), and it does not add a full monitoring stack (Prometheus/Grafana/etc.). This is meant to align with the Phase 1 Hosted API onboarding checklist language and reduce support tickets around 401/429/timeouts. Testing: Verified templates run end-to-end locally with a test key; smoke-tested README commands; validated markdown links. Follow-ups: PR-611 adds guided “first request” + “streaming” steps with copy matching Console checklist; SDK teams are landing default retry/backoff improvements in their repos and we’ll swap these snippets to the canonical helpers once stable.
commits: templates: add production readiness checklist section to root README
templates(node): add timeout + retry wrapper example and request_id logging
templates(python): add timeout guidance and structured logging snippet
docs: update Console usage dashboard link + rate limit callouts
chore: env var naming cleanup and markdown link fixes

release_notes: Quickstart templates now include a short “Before you ship to prod” checklist covering timeouts/retries, rate limit handling, prod API key hygiene, request ID logging, and where to verify usage/latency in the Redwood Console.
